AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#684 @ e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/1

Independent T4 audit, **AUD-SOL-F34-117, agent 117**, of F4's wiring, refund/dispute/admin paths, notice delivery/read ownership, sweep lease/budget and tests; candidate full CI is green, but two independently executed acceptance counterexamples remain. [Round 11](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/684#issuecomment-5976572584) [Independent exact-candidate probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177818656)

### Prior findings / evidence applicability

- **B-684-1 partially closed:** the cumulative `amount_refunded` convergence now repairs the USD 49-versus-40 payout/recovery mismatch even on duplicate delivery, but does not establish the complete canonical per-refund record requested in the prior verdict; the missing identity/reporting counterexample remains below. [Passing round-11 money assertions and independent identity failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177818656) [Prior Sol finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/684#issuecomment-5975867584)
- **B-684-2 closed at F4's changed notice/wrapper/cron boundaries:** unknown diagnostic canaries are replaced with closed codes/fixed provider-failure text, and channel failures remain failed/retryable. **C-684-1 closed:** both first-person strings are replaced and copy guard tests pass. [Executed round-11 controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177818656) [Round-11 changes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/684#issuecomment-5976572584)
- The cross-page live-held-amount behavior is repaired and tested; the new lookup's unbounded result size is separately C-684-4 below. [Executed pagination control](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177818656)
- G09: compared all 23 piece files to original Sol APPROVE `7c29d98121d931af04d68038f97aec601589e6a2`; **16 blobs are identical**, and the **7 changed files** (notice/purchase/refund/sweep services, email template, sweep spec and new round-11 spec) were reviewed independently, along with the full piece diff and surrounding production entry points. This reuses unchanged boundary evidence only, not the other lens's conclusions or a blanket approval of the new probes. [Original Sol approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/627#issuecomment-5964131926) [Current F4](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/684)

### B-684-1 — truncated webhook still loses canonical refund identities and amounts

**File:line:** `src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts:229–251,379–389`, with consumers `src/checkout/admin-analytics.service.ts:321–331,390` and the refund read/updated-event paths; the final cumulative settlement convergence repairs transfers but only the ten embedded refunds are upserted. [Refund ingestion and cumulative fallback](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts) [Financial reporting consumer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/admin-analytics.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** eleven succeeded refunds total USD 49: newest ten are USD 4 each and omitted `re_older` is USD 9; the complete provider-list fixture is available, but after two deliveries the local `ChargeRefund` table still contains only ten rows totaling **USD 40**, while the settlement correctly records **USD 49** and the coach transfer is fully reversed. `re_older` never enters refund lists/succeeded-refund accounting, and `refund.updated` returns `no_known_refund` for that missing id; the earnings rollup sums those incomplete rows rather than the complete refund amount. [Independent identity failure with passing money controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177818656) [Updated-event route](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts) [Stripe latest-ten contract](https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds/list)

**Minimal fix / verification:** obtain a bounded, complete canonical refund list for the affected charge (with continuation/retry on incompleteness), upsert identities, status, presentment amount/currency and dedupe state, then converge absolute settlement debits under the charge lock independently of individual applied flags. Preserve the now-correct cumulative money behavior and per-refund downstream decisions/alerts; test omitted older refunds, already-applied embedded rows, duplicate/out-of-order delivery, same-currency/FX controls and the resulting refund-list/rollup totals. [Prior acceptance rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/684#issuecomment-5975867584)

### B-684-3 — notice delivery ignores the sweep deadline and can outlive its runner lease

**File:line:** `src/checkout/purchase-split-handler.service.ts:232–236` passes no deadline to `PayoutNoticeService.dispatchPending`; `src/checkout/payout-notice.service.ts:145–158` processes all 25 notices with no between-row deadline check, although `settlement-sweep.cron.ts:32–33,99–102` promises an eight-minute budget inside a ten-minute lease. [Sweep handoff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/purchase-split-handler.service.ts) [Notice batch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/payout-notice.service.ts) [Runner budget/lease](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/settlement-sweep.cron.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** real sweep and notice services, 25 due notices, email disabled, synthetic push latency advancing `Date.now()` by 30 seconds per delivery: all **25** pushes start and complete, simulated elapsed **12.5 minutes**, rather than stopping new notice work after 16 pushes at eight minutes. This exceeds the ten-minute global lease and permits another machine to acquire it while the original is still starting channel side effects; no real sleeping or provider call was used in this proof. [Independent deadline failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177818656)

**Minimal fix / verification:** propagate the deadline through notice batching and check before starting each new notice/channel; bound/cancel individual provider work within the remaining safety window, keep unfinished channels durable/retryable and report deadline reached. Test a budget consumed by settlement work, slow notice channels, no due transfers and resume/receipt preservation; do not suppress notice functionality or mark unfinished delivery as sent. [Existing sweep/deferred-delivery contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/purchase-split-handler.service.ts)

### C-684-4 — optional: newest-notice lookup reads all historical matches

**File:line:** `src/checkout/payout-notice.service.ts:491–503`; the page itself is capped, but the new latest-row lookup has no result bound or latest-per-settlement reduction in the DB, reading every historical notice for the page's open settlements merely to retain one id per settlement. A limit-one page of a charge with 10,000 historical adjustment notices still materializes those 10,000 ids. Use a bounded deterministic latest-row-per-settlement query, preserving payee scope and the already-passing cross-page behavior. [Lookup implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e9ee033d425a61bb48efe2ac2387a23e5347acb0/src/checkout/payout-notice.service.ts)

### Exact-head evidence / boundaries

The independent source is this exact candidate plus the 92-line audit-only spec: **2 acceptance assertions fail / 46 controls pass**, including all 16 round-11 regression/copy/pagination tests and purchase-split/sweep/reconciliation controls; workflow head is `19cac0a9447b0bfaa35d75df63d8c1f58216b5ef`, source/probe commit `f8d406d97c19d0bf9df1e52dd9b4846562ded2ff`. [Independent CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37177818656)

Candidate full CI passes **719 suites / 12,401 tests**, with 23 skipped suites, 239 skipped tests and five todo; the three corrected F3 red-by-design suites are green here and other applicable stacked-base checks pass, with H4 deploy-readiness intentionally skipped and main-only CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM still an assembled-stack landing prerequisite. [Exact F4 full build](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37175734211/job/111357831986) [Readiness/gate scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/684#issuecomment-5976572584)

No F4 migration, package/lockfile change or later-piece import is introduced; notice read/acknowledge are scoped to the authenticated payee, and push/email dispatch stays post-webhook-commit with durable retry receipts. Findings in F3 or main-owned diagnostic/dispute-copy code are recorded for their owners, not counted as F4 blockers here; retain atomic rule-11 landing and mobile #321 pairing. At 2,995 changed lines, a further substantive fix/test round requires careful sizing or a logical re-split, never deleting coverage to fit. [F4 scope/landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/684)
